label: preparing
what: The evidence supports a coordinated, undisclosed bakery gathering/planning around a bridge-or-port change (nature and goal not substantiated); likely the participants reported at the bakery. A separate confirmed transaction was the builder paying the baker in materials for forty-four loaves; the record does not establish that order was part of the mayor's civic presentation preparations. The innkeeper and others were involved in that presentation, which the mayor approved, so it was not concealed from him.
